quotes.verbatim: '''Hamburger''' is a form of sustainable [[T-Spin Single]] stacking
The basic idea of Hamburger is to create this basic shape:
The obvious way to make a Hamburger is to use a Z piece.
After a few iterations, use an I piece to clear the excess.

nodes.label: the basic shape: a roof over the T's right end, a cover over a hole two columns left of the nub
the T soft-dropped stood up into the slot, before it rotates
the T rotated flat, nub down: a T-spin Single clearing the cover's row
the same shape built with a Z: the Z is the cover and the row under it
the shape again on top of the last cycle's residue: the well under it is deeper
a few cycles later: an I into the well clears the excess
what the TSS leaves (the page does not draw it): the well column open from the top to the floor

variants.window_note: in spin's frame, row 0 the top: the AGREEMENT BOX of the page's basic board, its two opener drawings with the T in (cross_source.page.drawings) and SDPC Spin's and stick spin's bag 1. Row 1 is the roof over the T's right end, open over the well; row 2 the T's row (the well cell left of it empty, the stack right of it filled); row 3 the row the TSS clears (the cover at the well and next to the nub, entailed by the clear at a full TSS, NaiveClauseForced); row 4 the hole under the cover at the well, filled beyond it. Occupancy only, never colour; garbage is filled, so a hole that is a garbage row's hole counts.

payoff.note: a Tetris into the well, the step the page names (「After a few iterations, use an I piece to clear the excess.」) and draws (its Tetris board). A well that the next piece into its column fills without a Tetris is another cycle of the stacking (the page's Repeat board), not a failure; the matcher carries the well cell to the first later lock that puts a cell in its column and asks whether that lock is an I the engine credits with four lines

cross_source.note: the window, by the gate's predicate (technique_transcription.window_fires), over every U-slot board of every committed *-routes.json, with the U cells as the T: it fires on SDPC Spin's two bag-1 TSS boards (harddrop's SDPC_Spin page, another page) and on stick spin's bag-1 TSS board mirrored (shiwehi.com, another site). Those three are also the window's external agreement drawings, beside the page's own two opener drawings (`page`).

page.note: every board of the pinned revision after the six transcribed ones, read with `wikitext_readings`.
